==Senator Elections==
Each summit, a number of nations will elect [[Senator|senators]] for one or more of their territories to serve in the [[Senate]]. Each nation has a unique method of electing its senators. At the Summer Solstice 387YE, the following nations will elect Senators at the times listed in the table below, inside each nation's camp.
<table class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible">
<tr><th>Nation</th><th>Time</th><th>Territories with Senator elections</th><th>Notes</th></tr>
<tr><td>[[The Brass Coast leadership|Brass Coast]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Feroz]]</td><td>Auction begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Dawn leadership|Dawn]]</td><td>2:30pm</td><td>[[Weirwater]]</td><td>Immediately after the tourney</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Highguard leadership|Highguard]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Bastion]]</td><td>Inquisition of candidates begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[The League leadership|League]]</td><td>3:30pm</td><td>[[Sarvos]]<br>[[Spiral]]</td><td>Presentation of collected bonds</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[The Marches leadership|Marches]]</td><td>1:30pm</td><td>[[Mitwold]]</sup></td><td>[[Farm|Landowners]] gather</tr>
<tr><td>[[Navarr leadership|Navarr]]</td><td>1:15pm</td><td>[[Miaren]]</td><td>Immediately after standing</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Urizen leadership|Urizen]]</td><td>1:00pm</td><td>[[Redoubt]]</td><td>Demos begins (to conclude at 1:30pm)</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Varushka leadership|Varushka]]</td><td>1:45pm</td><td>[[Karov]]</td><td>Questioning of candidates begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Wintermark political leadership|Wintermark]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Sermersuaq]]</td><td>Jars are placed down for 15 minutes</td></tr>
</table>

==Tally of the Votes==
Each summit, a number of national titles are elected via [[Tally of the Votes]]. At the Summer Solstice 387YE, elections for such titles will take place at the following times for the nations listed, in the order shown:

<tr><td>4:00pm</td><td>Varushka</td><td>Central Hearth</td><td>[[Granites of Veltsgorsk]]<br>[[Boyar of the Iron Roads]]<br>[[Burgher of Ketsov]]<br>[[Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile]]</td></tr>
<tr><td>4:30pm</td><td>Highguard</td><td>Chapel</td><td>[[Vigilant Swan]]<br>[[Cinderpath Custodian]]<br>[[Golden Fleet Salvagemaster]]<br>[[Exarch of Virtue's Rest]]<sup>[[#2|(2)]]</sup><br>[[Steward of the Ossuary]]<sup>[[#2|(2)]]</sup></td></tr>

==Timetable==
This timetable and much more information can be seen on the notices that get pinned up all around the Hub after time-in. <br />
For any queries regarding the IC timetabling at events you can talk to the civil service staff in the Hub.

=== Citizen Bookings ===
Citizens can request to book Civil Service spaces, as detailed [[Anvil#Booking_Civil_Service_Spaces|here]]. Official meetings organised by the Civil Service are listed in darker shading, whilst such citizen-organised meetings are shown in a lighter colour, as below.

</table>
